title: Python: String Operations
description: Write a Python program that demonstrates common string methods and operations.

codeTemplate.py:
text = "  Hello, Python World!  "
print(f"Original: '{text}'")
print(f"Strip: '{text.strip()}'")
print(f"Upper: {text.upper().strip()}")
print(f"Replace: {text.replace('World', 'Universe').strip()}")
print(f"Split: {text.strip().split(', ')}")
print(f"Starts with Hello: {text.strip().startswith('Hello')}")

verificationTest: output.includes("Original: '  Hello, Python World!  '") && output.includes("Upper: HELLO, PYTHON WORLD!") && output.includes("Split: ['Hello', 'Python World!']") && output.includes('Starts with Hello: True')
hints: `.split(sep)` divides a string into a list using sep as delimiter
